title: map, filter & folds
hints: README 'New syntax': `filter`, `map`, `foldr`, `foldl`. average returns `Maybe Double`: either `Nothing` or `Just` a number.

squaresOfOdds: filter the odd ones, then map a square. total: foldr with (+) and 0. countIf: filter with p, then count. longestWord: fold over `words` keeping the best so far (replace only when strictly longer). average: [] → Nothing, else Just (sum / count as a Double).
Other data: `map (* 10) (filter even [1 .. 5])` → [20,40] · `foldl (\best x -> if x > best then x else best) 0 [3, 9, 4]` → 9 · `Just (sum [1.0, 2.0])`.

`squaresOfOdds xs = map (^ 2) (filter odd xs)` · `longestWord s = foldl pick "" (words s) where pick best w = if length w > length best then w else best` · `average xs = Just (sum xs / fromIntegral (length xs))` after an `average [] = Nothing` line.
